notes.CHN: FRA 的「中國」土地面積（94,247 萬公頃）含台灣、香港、澳門，森林面積只有中國大陸，所以覆蓋率改用中國大陸的土地面積（93,882 萬公頃，FAOSTAT）計算
notes.TWN: FRA 沒有台灣。改用農業部林業及自然保育署的全國森林資源調查：第三次（1990–1993 年，台灣本島）森林 210.2 萬公頃、覆蓋率 58.53%，標在 1990 年；第四次（2008–2013 年實地調查，2015 年公布，含金門、連江）森林 219.7 萬公頃、土地 361.9 萬公頃、覆蓋率 60.71%，標在 2010 年。之後還沒有新的調查結果，2015 年以後的地圖顯示 2010 年的值

notesEn.CHN: FRA's 'China' land area (942.47 million ha) includes Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macao, but its forest area covers mainland China only, so coverage is calculated with mainland China's land area (938.82 million ha, FAOSTAT)
notesEn.TWN: FRA does not cover Taiwan. The Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency's national forest resource inventories are used instead: the third (1990–1993, main island) found 2.102 million ha of forest, 58.53% coverage, shown as 1990; the fourth (field surveys in 2008–2013, published in 2015, including Kinmen and Matsu) found 2.197 million ha of forest on 3.619 million ha of land, 60.71%, shown as 2010. No later inventory has been published, so maps from 2015 on show the 2010 value
